description: Read `agent`'s global application configuration (`agent` is a name from mcp_agents_list), grouped: `notifications` (`webhook` + `webhook_key`), `bridges` (matter/homekit/homebridge callbacks), `settings` (docs_enabled, logs_enabled, log_days), `sensors`, and configured pins (`gpios`). The `agent` block (platform, os, ip, cpu_temperature, version) is computed live on every read and is not stored. Change the name, key, webhook and settings with mcp_config_write; mcp_config_load replaces the whole config.
name: mcp_config_read
title: Read agent config
